title: JFrog token placeholders, references and masked displays
summary: The documented Bearer and Basic request forms with their placeholders, an environment reference, a bare scheme, a masked display and prose under the token names.
rationale: A placeholder such as the documented Bearer or Basic form, a reference or a masked display carries no token value, and a bare scheme names none. Flagging them would redact documentation a reader needs. The case says nothing about the platform access token and the MyJFrog API token being the same kind.

expectation.rationale: Project policy, maintainer-only (ADR 0020, credential-evidence#235). Finalized by the sole maintainer alone: not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). The question, options, strongest dissent and reversing evidence are in the review history. Not flagged under project policy: these inputs hold no token value. That a placeholder, reference, bare scheme or masked display is not a value is the project's decision, not a JFrog statement.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy. Parser behaviour, action and product attribution stay with the downstream repositories.
